definitions.open: Every STILL OPEN cyc add across all sessions, not just active-session additions; gross mark-to-market and remaining-entry-fee/rebate-aware PnL; prospective exit estimate separately labeled
definitions.skip: Otherwise eligible new rescue-add third-tick signals blocked by pre-placement unrounded margin>=50%; not candle count, not rechecks; no fill-time or prospective cap

User ABS unit formula; exact mark +/-0.05%, no extra SLIP; estimate fee.05%, actualtaker.042%/rebate70%, proportional entry fees and residual original TP. definitions.filter_counts: Normal logical pending-entry plans / market attempts. Each new plan attempted once; rejected placement vs later pending cancellation separated. Per-rule counts overlap when multiple conditions match; totals are unique events, not sum-of-rules. Includes plans held by other baseline controls, NOT counterfactual successful fills exclusively prevented by filter. blocked_side_minutes counts each enabled rule once per side at minute-open; denominator side_minutes=2*replayed1m candles. No per-minute repeated cancellation counts.
definitions.filter_timing: Minute OPEN currentprice, completed HTF close<=minuteopen; cancel normal pending BEFORE samebar fills. After on_1m, update completedUTC HTF with thisminute then close-bar placement uses minuteclose and newlycompletedHTF. Market triggers also checked at modeled triggerprice; minute OHLC cannot prove intrabar gate crossings. No queue/volume model; inherited fillmechanics unchanged.
